debug.description: Operator diagnostic flag. Omit for ordinary recall.

exclude_topics.description: Optional topic keys to exclude from the caller's results. A relevance filter, never an access boundary.

from.description: Inclusive lower time bound as Unix milliseconds, not seconds. Omit for no lower bound.

include_lanes.description: Operator diagnostic: include retrieval-channel details. Omit for ordinary recall.

include_topics.description: Optional topic keys to include in the caller's results. A relevance filter, never an access grant.

kinds.description: Optional memory-type filter. Omit to search all supported kinds.

limit.description: Maximum results to return. Omit for the server default; request only the amount of context needed.

profile.description: Optional retrieval preset: precise, balanced or broad. Omit for configured behavior.

query.description: Describe the current task and which earlier preferences, decisions, constraints or lessons would help. Use natural language, not database syntax.

response_id.description: A retrieval response identifier returned by Stowage; used for attribution or audit, not a query.

session_id.description: An existing host session reference. Omit unless a session-specific operation requires it; verified host identity takes precedence.

until.description: Upper time bound as Unix milliseconds, not seconds. Omit for no upper bound.

view_name.description: An existing named topic view for this caller. Omit for the default view.
